Swiss Army Bench 0.0.3: the page opens.

- **`swissarmybench start` and `swissarmybench open` open the app's page** (`/workspace`). 0.0.2 opened the bare
  address, which had no page and answered "Missing or wrong token". The bare address now goes on to the page too,
  so an address typed or bookmarked without `/workspace` works.

Update (stop the running server first: Ctrl+C, or `swissarmybench stop`):

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
